echo "== positive test: key-based ssh as opsbot from node1 to node2 =="
sudo -n -u opsbot ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o BatchMode=yes -i /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 opsbot@10.100.237.11 'whoami && hostname'
